mostWorthwhile.text: Following the nursery outflow into the cold cloud was most worthwhile: it connected the earlier clearing to a new episode of star formation.

leastWorthwhile.text: The tail-star combination was less compelling because heating the gas was fairly predictable, although the swept-up shell added detail.

surprise.text: I didn't expect the outflow's collision with the cloud to lead to new stars after the shocked gas cooled.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the combinations had clear physical purposes, though the fast-mode menu supplied their compatibility.

continue.text: Yes. I'd be curious to follow the surviving disk material and the newly formed stars into their next encounters.
